My high conscientiousness demands accuracy; low openness makes me wary of full reliance. Better for arts/literature innovation than my hated math."},"reasoning_summary":"Answers portray a conscientious, highly neurotic, introverted 22-year-old man who despises math, expresses anxiety openly, gives effortful but imperfect technical explanations reflecting discomfort and low openness, prefers arts, consistent with immigrant professional persona in human mode."}
